data.name: Mohtasim
data.gender_notes: Mohtasim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘hts’, meaning ‘to agree’ or ‘to be satisfied’. In Islamic contexts, it can symbolize a person who is agreeable, just, and righteous. The name Mohtasim carries the meaning “Accepted, Agreed upon” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mohtasim usually hope their child will grow to embody accepted, agreed upon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes agreement with Allah's will and righteousness.
data.etymology: Mohtasim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Accepted, Agreed upon.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mohtasim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
